title: VIDEO ROOM 1000 COMPLETE MIX -- All 1000 videos seen in sequential order!
summary: A condensed rendition of a project that re-uploaded one video to YouTube 1000 times, showing the accumulating compression artifacts. It pays homage to Alvin Lucier's I Am Sitting in a Room.
why: Cited as a vivid demonstration of generation loss from repeated lossy re-encoding.

quote.text: Every time you render and recompress you're losing information, it's lossy compression after all.
